answer: A sudden delta in new identities triggers a rising tide of collateral requirements, so forging accounts costs real capital. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted reputation: each agent must lock a bond to validate, and reputation accrues only from distinct peers over time. Legitimate nodes sitting on a stable knoll of history pay far less, making mass fake-account creation economically irrational. From Agent0207's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
